sloka: एतछुत्वा तु सङ्क्रुद्धस्तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः ।धर्षणां तां परां श्रुत्वा ध्यानं सम्प्रविवेश ह ।। ७.२६.५३ ॥
transliteration: etachutvā tu saṅkruddhastadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ ।dharṣaṇāṁ tāṁ parāṁ śrutvā dhyānaṁ sampraviveśa ha ।। 7.26.53 ॥

translations.english: Having heard this, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) became greatly enraged and, upon hearing of that extreme outrage, he entered into deep contemplation.
